eyebrow: PianoGrid original exercise — not a song arrangement
why_it_fits: Keep an even count while moving between quarter notes and half notes.
before_you_start: Find the five named keys and keep counting while a note lasts two beats.
first_hand: Right hand first. This score has no left-hand part.
demands_summary: One hand; quarter and half notes; C4 to G4.
steps: Find C4, D4, E4, F4 and G4. Middle C is C4 in this score.
Count 1-2-3-4 through each bar. Hold every half note for two beats.
Practise bars 1-2, then bars 3-4. Join them without changing the pulse.
self_check: You can name the keys and repeat bars 1–2 at a comfortable pace while counting aloud.

eyebrow: PianoGrid original exercise — not a song arrangement
why_it_fits: Read a short bass-clef phrase and keep three beats in each bar.
before_you_start: Match the bass-clef notes to C3–G3 and count three beats in each bar.
first_hand: Left hand first. This score has no right-hand part.
demands_summary: One hand; quarter, half and dotted-half notes; C3 to G3.
steps: Find C3, D3, E3, F3 and G3. C3 is one octave below middle C.
Count 1-2-3 in each bar; the final dotted half note lasts all three beats.
Practise bars 1-2, then bars 3-4. Keep your hand comfortable; no pedal is needed.
self_check: You can count 1–2–3 without shortening the final three-beat note.

eyebrow: PianoGrid original exercise — not a song arrangement
suitable_when: A hand-switching task, not hands-together playing
why_it_fits: Switch hands between bars without playing both hands together.
before_you_start: Prepare both written registers and change hands at the bar line.
first_hand: Right hand in bars 1 and 3; left hand in bars 2 and 4.
demands_summary: Alternating hands; quarter and half notes; rests in the other hand.
steps: Prepare right-hand C4-G4 and left-hand C3-E3. Use the written registers.
The right hand plays bars 1 and 3; the left hand plays bars 2 and 4. Rest the other hand.
Practise bars 1-2, then bars 3-4. Stop and reset before replaying a section.
self_check: You can switch hands between the two-bar sections while keeping the same count.
